summary.text: Matt Hall is a Republican state representative from Michigan House District 42 and Speaker of the Michigan House of Representatives, a post he assumed on January 8, 2025. He is an attorney who has served in the House since 2019 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026 against Democrat Nick Rowe.

paragraphs.text: Matt Hall was born in 1983 and earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from Western Michigan University in 2006 and a J.D. from Cooley Law School in 2017.
He worked as a constitutional law attorney, the West Michigan liaison for the Michigan Attorney General's Office, and a business development representative for L-3 Combat Propulsion Systems.
In 2018 Hall ran to represent District 63 in the state House, and in the Republican primary he defeated incumbent Rep. David Maturen.
After voters re-elected him in 2020, redistricting moved him to District 42 in 2022.
During his first term he chaired the House Oversight Committee, and he later chaired the Tax Policy Committee in the 2021-2022 session.
